result.instructions: Tools for Shirtigo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my orders are still open, and when were they placed?"; "List my projects and how many products each one has."; "What would an order of 20 black shirts to Germany cost before I place it?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shirtigo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shirtigo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shirtigo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shirtigo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shirtigo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Return the Shirtigo account behind the API key: name, company, country, user group, billing validity and integration count. Good first call to confirm the connection. Cockpit API: GET /user.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List product collections (projects) of the account, newest first by default. A project groups the products built from its base products and designs. Cockpit API: GET /projects.

sort_col.description: Sort column: name, reference, url, default_preview_position, created_at, updated_at.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Return one project (collection) by its reference, including its status and processing areas. Cockpit API: GET /projects/{reference}.

reference.description: The project reference (string, as returned by the API).

tools.name: shirtigo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the account's finished or in-progress products (base product + design combinations), with optional filters by project, design, base product, tag or name search. Cockpit API: GET /products.

project_id.description: Only products of this project reference.

design_id.description: Only products that use this design reference.

base_product_id.description: Only products of this base product id.

search.description: Search in product and collection names.

finished.description: 1 = only products whose rendering is finished.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Return one product by its numeric id, optionally with live stock per variant. Cockpit API: GET /products/{product-id}.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_base_products
tools.title: List base products
tools.description: Search the Shirtigo catalog of blank base products (shirts, hoodies, mugs, ...). Filter by category id or by SKU substring. Cockpit API: GET /base-products.

sku.description: Return base products with a variant whose SKU contains this value.

user_products_only.description: Include only products specific to this account.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_base_product
tools.title: Get base product
tools.description: Return one base product by id, with its colors and sizes. Cockpit API: GET /base-products/{base-product-id}.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_categories
tools.title: List base product categories
tools.description: List the category ids of the base product catalog (use them to filter shirtigo_list_base_products). Cockpit API: GET /base-categories.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_designs
tools.title: List designs
tools.description: List the print designs (motifs) uploaded to the account. A design is reused across products. Cockpit API: GET /designs.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_design
tools.title: Get design
tools.description: Return one design by reference: file info, colors, preview URLs and processing status. Cockpit API: GET /designs/{design-reference}.

reference.description: The design reference (string, as returned by the API).

tools.name: shirtigo_create_design_from_url
tools.title: Create design from URL
tools.description: Upload a print design to the account from a public image URL. It creates a new design record only; no product is ordered. Cockpit API: POST /designs/url.

url.description: Public URL of the design file (PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF).

processingmethod.description: Print method the design is for.

tools.name: shirtigo_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create an empty project (product collection) that later receives products. It is a new account record; no product is ordered. Cockpit API: POST /projects.

tools.name: shirtigo_predict_order_price
tools.title: Predict order price
tools.description: Calculate the total price (products, shipping, VAT) for a planned order of existing products by SKU, without placing an order. Cockpit API: POST /orders/predict-price.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE. See /delivery-countries.

sku.description: SKU of an existing product or warehouse product (starts with WV-).

tools.name: shirtigo_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders placed by the account, paginated. Filter by order status id and sort the list. Cockpit API: GET /orders.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Return one order by its reference: status, prices, delivery address, products and shipments. Cockpit API: GET /orders/{order_reference}.

order_reference.description: The order reference (string, as returned by the API).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Shirtigo
prompts.description: What you can do with Shirtigo here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_status_of_placed_orders
prompts.title: Check the status of placed orders
prompts.description: List orders placed by the account, filtered by status. Open one order for its prices, delivery address and shipments.

prompts.name: price_a_planned_order_before_you_place_it
prompts.title: Price a planned order before you place it
prompts.description: Calculate the total for existing products by SKU, with shipping and VAT. The tool places no order.

prompts.name: browse_the_blank_base_product_catalog
prompts.title: Browse the blank base product catalog
prompts.description: Search base products by category or SKU. Open one base product for its colors and sizes.

prompts.name: review_projects_and_the_products_in_them
prompts.title: Review projects and the products in them
prompts.description: List projects, open one by its reference, and list the products filtered by that project.

prompts.name: upload_a_print_design_from_a_url
prompts.title: Upload a print design from a URL
prompts.description: Upload a print design from a public image URL, then read its preview and processing status. No product is ordered.

prompts.name: create_an_empty_project_for_new_products
prompts.title: Create an empty project for new products
prompts.description: Create an empty project that later receives products. No product is ordered.
